summary: The wizard timeout display is missing. The accepted v35 evaluation and a fresh replay on the current B168 branch both match through the first 43 screens and all 2347 random-number calls, then JavaScript stops at #timeout before C emits boundary 44. Native pointer formatting is now deterministic in published recorder patch 007 and has a canonical JavaScript implementation in B168, but B168 is still queued and reserves alloc.c:fmt_ptr plus contract:native-pointer-diagnostic-format; wait for its acceptance before claiming timeout implementation scope. The accepted B185 work was the wizard panic path and did not relocate timeout.c propertynames: js/wizcmds.js still keeps WIZ_INTRINSIC_PROPERTIES privately, so reconciliation with property_by_index remains required in the eventual whole timeout task. No timeout.c source credit is established.

source.branch: timeout.c:2041-2124 implements the #timeout extended command: create an NHW_MENU, print current moves, active timers, timed properties in propertynames[] order, optional swallow/vault counters, visible-region summary, and level stasis countdown; display then destroy the window. The queue branch is empty in the admitted case, but populated rows consume fmt_ptr(curr->arg.a_void).
callers: cmd.c:doextcmd(493-521) dispatches the timeout row at cmd.c:1903-1904, flagged IFBURIED|AUTOCOMPLETE|WIZMODECMD. js/extcmdlist_data.js:138 retains the row; js/cmd.js:4983+ owns doextcmd dispatch but has no wiz_timeout_queue arm and currently fails closed through UnsupportedHeroTimeoutBoundaryError.
cmd.c:rhack(3682-3825) invokes the selected extended-command function and resets repeat counts after ECMD_OK; preserve the command return and display dismissal behavior at this call seam.

wizcmds.c:wiz_intrinsic(949-1098) calls timeout.c:property_by_index to construct and resolve its property menu. Current js/wizcmds.js:495-562 still has its private WIZ_INTRINSIC_PROPERTIES list; the accepted B185 implementation commit 0f268f2c2d6a6186247bb68d29b6b90314c64efc only changed the wizard panic path and does not own or block table relocation.
dependencies: Published recorder patch 007 (execution commit d399398f872cf682ce5ed796bbd6c66704dde739, on published Main be68a3dc47a6fe9f8ce693c94cb11b91a85a3afe) now emits deterministic <ptr>/<null> text. B168 implements the canonical alloc.c:fmt_ptr port in js/alloc.js, but B168 delivery e84881494367c1c521efb8ca6c4d6f93a406e434 remains queued and retains source:alloc.c:fmt_ptr plus contract:native-pointer-diagnostic-format. This is the current ownership gate: do not claim or edit timeout implementation scope until B168 is accepted. timeout.c:print_queue consumes fmt_ptr for every populated timer row; VERBOSE_TIMER is defined, so the C-format pointer argument is used.

timeout.c:kind_name(1995-2012) returns names for TIMER_NONE, TIMER_LEVEL, TIMER_GLOBAL, TIMER_OBJECT, TIMER_MONSTER, and unknown values. TIMER_NONE calls impossible("no timer type") and discards its result; retain an explicit gap for that discarded diagnostic if impossible remains unported. Empty print_queue skips kind_name and fmt_ptr, so the admitted empty-queue replay alone cannot establish the whole print_queue family.

region.c:any_visible_region(660-671) is a required returned-value callee: it returns true at the first visible region whose ttl is not -2, otherwise false. The canonical list is state.level.regions; port this helper and source-pin its result instead of deriving visibility from a display cache.

region.c:visible_region_summary(674-714) writes to the timeout menu: traverse visible nonexpired regions in list order, emit the header once, display ttl+1, choose vapor or poison-gas damage text, and format bounding boxes using menu_tab_sep. The complete timeout display needs this source behavior, with independent gas-region evidence.

timeout.c:propertynames(30-114) is the fixed source-ordered table shared by #timeout and #wizintrinsic; generate the canonical JS data from C deterministically. Port and source-pin property_by_index(117-125), including its invalid-index sentinel and optional output parameter, then make js/wizcmds.js consume that canonical owner. B185 acceptance clears its prior reservation, but the current private table confirms this remains required implementation work rather than an ownership blocker.

Use the existing TTY NHW_MENU/window and tty_menu output/dismissal owners for create_nhwindow, putstr, display_nhwindow, and destroy_nhwindow. Preserve C output order and wait behavior; no timer creation, callback, or general turn-loop expansion is needed.

evidence: Current saved queue entry at 438d5d0cd3f837bbc821b6ff78ce82940470a5f8 reports 43/67 screens and cursors, 2347/2347 RNG calls, and 24 remaining screens. Queue provenance is refreshed to challenges/evaluations/accepted-438d5d0cd3f837bbc821b6ff78ce82940470a5f8-v35.json; the challenge recording and recipe hashes are unchanged.

Fresh differential: node scripts/diff-fresh.mjs challenges/cases/v35/v35-timeout-queue.recipe.session.json at examined commit e84881494367c1c521efb8ca6c4d6f93a406e434 (receipt /tmp/teleport-validation-1000/run-NKhnBB/receipt.json). C and JS RNG values match (2347 calls). C has 67 screens/cursors, JS has 43; first missing JS output is boundary 44, segment 1, step 44, key newline, after the unsupported #timeout command. The prior 43 screen/cursor boundaries match.

The independent admitted recipe drinks an uncursed speed potion then requests #timeout. It reaches the empty active timer queue and temporary FAST property; it does not cover populated timer rows, native pointer arguments, or visible regions. B168 contains an independent lit-lamp #lightsources recording that emits <ptr>, but its allocator ownership is not released before acceptance.

Source trace checked at the current C checkout: timeout.c:30-125 defines the shared ordered property table and index helper; timeout.c:1995-2124 covers kind_name, print_queue, and wiz_timeout_queue; region.c:660-714 covers the required region helpers. cmd.c:doextcmd and rhack provide production command entry and result-reset seams.

Current source-owner status: B185 was accepted and its implementation delivery changes the wizard panic path only; it neither relocated the property table nor retains a reservation. B168 is queued and is the sole current owner of alloc.c:fmt_ptr and contract:native-pointer-diagnostic-format. This investigation is session-only and establishes no implementation or runtime completion for timeout.c.
